_comment: THE CHECKS busbar declares for the release turnstile beyond the `cargo xtask gate` battery (busbar-release-turnstile `pipeline.rs`: a check runs when the rung being entered is in its `rungs`; `run` is one bash line run in the checkout with pipefail; every `<id>\t<PASS|FAIL|SKIP>\t<title>\t<detail>` line it prints is a ledger row). fuzz-smoke: every coverage-guided harness `fuzz/Cargo.toml` declares as a `[[bin]]` is built with libFuzzer's coverage instrumentation on the pinned stable toolchain (the flags cargo-fuzz passes, so no nightly and no cargo-fuzz install) and run for 60 s from an empty corpus; a harness that does not build or crashes is a FAIL row, and a manifest declaring no harness is a FAIL, never a pass that fuzzed nothing (Law 8). The harnesses are a separate workspace, so this is the only place they build. Run at the qa and main rungs, where the removed qa-fuzz.yml ran. signing-gate: the first-party signature proof on a plugin built against the 1.6.0 SDK, with nothing published. The fixture is busbar-secret-env-plugin from the fleet repo at the rev busbar's own Cargo.lock pins (resolved through `cargo metadata`, the same resolve build-test's dropped-in cdylibs use); scripts/signing-gate.sh builds busbar with the gate's ephemeral key embedded and proves a first-party tarball signed by that key validates, while the same plugin unsigned, signed by another key, or tampered (library or manifest) is refused. WHAT IT DOES NOT PROVE: that a SHIPPED binary embeds the REAL release key. Only a signature by the real private half can show that, and no plugin built against the 1.6.0 SDK is published yet; the release_pubkey row (the 64-hex key present in the artifact's bytes) is the shipped binary's only key proof until busbar-store-sqlite publishes its first 1.6.0-SDK release and release-targets.json's plugin_probe moves to it at `expect_status: ready`.

checks.run:
host=$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p'); targets=$(awk '/^\[\[bin\]\]/{b=1;next} b&&/^name *=/{gsub(/^name *= *"|"$/,"");print;b=0}' fuzz/Cargo.toml); [ -n "$targets" ] || { printf 'fuzz-smoke:targets	FAIL	the fuzz harnesses	fuzz/Cargo.toml declares no [[bin]] target, so this check would fuzz nothing
'; exit 1; }; rc=0; for t in $targets; do if RUSTFLAGS='-Cpasses=sancov-module -Cllvm-args=-sanitizer-coverage-level=4 -Cllvm-args=-sanitizer-coverage-inline-8bit-counters -Cllvm-args=-sanitizer-coverage-pc-table -Cllvm-args=-sanitizer-coverage-trace-compares --cfg fuzzing -Cdebug-assertions -Coverflow-checks' cargo build --release --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --target-dir fuzz/target --target "$host" --bin "$t" >&2 && mkdir -p "fuzz/target/corpus-$t" && "fuzz/target/$host/release/$t" "fuzz/target/corpus-$t" -max_total_time=60 >&2; then printf 'fuzz-smoke:%s	PASS	%s	60 s, no crash
' "$t" "$t"; else printf 'fuzz-smoke:%s	FAIL	%s	the harness did not build, or crashed within 60 s
' "$t" "$t"; rc=1; fi; done; exit $rc

m=$(cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(next(p["manifest_path"] for p in json.load(sys.stdin)["packages"] if p["name"]=="busbar-secret-env"))') || { printf 'signing-gate:fixture	FAIL	the pinned fleet plugin	busbar resolves no busbar-secret-env; nothing to build the 1.6.0-SDK fixture from
'; exit 1; }; ws=$(dirname "$(dirname "$m")"); case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) ext=dylib;; *) ext=so;; esac; cargo build --manifest-path "$ws/Cargo.toml" -p busbar-secret-env-plugin --target-dir target/signing-gate-fixture >&2 && lib="target/signing-gate-fixture/debug/libbusbar_secret_env_plugin.$ext" && [ -f "$lib" ] || { printf 'signing-gate:fixture	FAIL	the pinned fleet plugin	busbar-secret-env-plugin at the pinned rev did not build
'; exit 1; }; if bash scripts/signing-gate.sh . busbar-secret-env-plugin secret signing-gate-env "$lib" >&2; then printf 'signing-gate:secret-env	PASS	busbar-secret-env-plugin (pinned, 1.6.0 SDK)	signed loads; unsigned, wrong-key and tampered are refused
'; else printf 'signing-gate:secret-env	FAIL	busbar-secret-env-plugin (pinned, 1.6.0 SDK)	scripts/signing-gate.sh failed; see its output
'; exit 1; fi
